alt: Exercise 1.3 · Q8: The annual income of Tayyab is Rs. 9,60,000, while the exempted amount is Rs. 1,30,000. How much tax would he have to pay at the rate of 0.75%?

steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Annual income }=Rs.9,60,000\\[5pt]&\text{Exempted amount }=Rs.1,30,000\\[5pt]&\text{Taxable income }=9,60,000-1,30,000=\\[5pt]&\quad Rs.8,30,000\\[5pt]&\text{Tax }=0.75\%\text{ of }8,30,000\\[5pt]&\quad =\frac{0.75}{100}\times 8,30,000\\[5pt]&\quad =Rs.6,225\\[5pt]&\text{Tayyab has to pay }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{Rs. }\mathbf{6,225}}\text{ tax.}\end{aligned}\]
